manufacturerInfo.name: Zeus
manufacturerInfo.description: Extruded PTFE AWG tubing. Walls: the nominal walls of Zeus's Standard (0.13/0.23/0.30/0.41/0.51 mm), Thin (0.13/0.23/0.25/0.30/0.38 mm) and Lightweight (0.15/0.20/0.25/0.30 mm) wall classes from the metric table of the AWG tubing sheet V1R2; which walls exist depends on the AWG size (0.41 mm standard wall only for AWG 20 to 10). Dielectric strength: 'Dielectric Strength (V/mil) D149 457 - 483' from the Zeus PTFE material sheet V2R4 (https://www.zeusinc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/PTFE-Material-V2R4.pdf); the lower bound 457 V/mil is recorded, and because the sheet states no specimen thickness it is recorded at each published wall. Dielectric constant 2.10 at 1 MHz (D150), maximum service temperature in air 260 C, melt temperature 326-327 C (D4591, lower bound recorded). Zeus: 'not intended to constitute a specification'.

manufacturerInfo.name: Alpha Wire
manufacturerInfo.description: Flexible 2:1 irradiated polyolefin heat-shrink tubing, UL Standard 224 (except clear), MIL-DTL-23053/5 class 1 and 2. Walls: the nominal recovered walls of the published sizes 3/64 in to 4 in (0.41, 0.43, 0.50, 0.63, 0.76, 0.88, 1.02, 1.16, 1.27, 1.40 mm); each wall belongs to one size range and is thinner when recovery is restricted. Dielectric strength: 'Dielectric Strength: 500V/mil (197 kV/cm)'; the datasheet states no specimen thickness, so the value is recorded at each published recovered wall. Volume resistivity 10^14 ohm-cm. Operating temperature -55 to 135 C. No dielectric constant is published.
